title: Item-side Fairness of Large Language Model-based Recommendation System

bias_targets.methodology: Dividing items into groups based on their historical interaction counts and measuring the disparity between the groups' recommendation proportions in top-K outputs and their historical interaction proportions using Mean Group Unfairness (MGU) and Disparity Group Unfairness (DGU).

Categorizing items by their genre (e.g., movie or game genres) and calculating Group Unfairness (GU) to evaluate whether the recommendation model disproportionately over-recommends or overlooks specific item genres compared to historical interaction baselines.
